description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class that listens for system broadcast intents such as boot completion, network connectivity changes, and Bluetooth state changes, and triggers a service accordingly.

classes.name: GceBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles system broadcast intents related to device boot, network changes, and Bluetooth state changes, and starts a service based on the received intent.

methods.name: reportIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent targeting GceService with a specific action and starts it as a foreground service.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents, logs the received action, and triggers the appropriate service action based on the intent.
